title: Rounding a Dispute Rebill, by Recent Card Use
content:
How the figure obtained for a dispute rebill on a card under Personal Credit Cards is rounded is read from the card's own recent use.

1. Where at least 6 card payments have posted to this card account in the last twelve months and card purchases posted to it in the last six months total at least 4000.00 USD, the figure is rounded half-up to the nearest whole dollar.

2. Where at least 6 card payments have posted to this card account in the last twelve months and those purchases total less than 4000.00 USD, the figure is reduced to the whole dollar below it.

3. Where fewer than 6 card payments have posted in the last twelve months, the figure is rounded half-up to the cent.

| Card payments in the last twelve months | Card purchases in the last six months | How the figure is rounded |
|---|---|---|
| 11 | 9200.00 USD | half-up to the nearest whole dollar |
| 6 | 4000.00 USD | half-up to the nearest whole dollar |
| 6 | 3999.00 USD | reduced to the whole dollar below |
| 5 | 40000.00 USD | half-up to the cent |

**Worked on hypothetical figures.** A figure of 534.50 becomes 535.00 USD under the first convention, 534.00 USD under the second and 534.50 USD under the third. A figure of 157.7475 becomes 158.00 USD, 157.00 USD and 157.75 USD respectively. Where fewer than 6 card payments have posted in the last twelve months the purchase total is not reached at all.
